title: Barley risotto with chicken, leek and mountain cheese
steps: Chop the shallot, slice the leek and dice the carrot.
Rinse the barley and sweat it with the vegetables in 1 tsp oil for 3 minutes.
Add the hot stock gradually and simmer for 35–40 minutes, stirring now and then, until the barley is tender.
Dice the chicken, fry it in the remaining oil for 5 minutes and season.
Stir the chicken and grated cheese into the barley and serve with parsley.
